```{r}
#| label: tbl-smoke

#| apa-note: "N = 200."

  apa_col("Predictor", "l", list("Adverts", "Airplay")) |>
  apa_col(apa_sym("b"), "r", list(richtext(".08"), richtext(".90"))) |>
  apa_spec_finish(title = "Synthetic Demonstration Table", number = 1L)
apa.quarto.pdf(spec)
```
